description: Files and folders under src/ whose errors are all coded, checked by tools/lint/error-codes.mjs. A folder ends with a slash. A plain Error, TypeError, RangeError or SyntaxError throw that has to stay is listed in retainedPlainThrows with the throw as written and the reason it stays.

retainedPlainThrows.reason: Thrown inside a try whose catch right below it returns a malformed or unresolved verification result; it never leaves verifyComponentSignature.
